description: Chamber of Construction Industry of Sri Lanka - Chamber of Construction Industry of Sri Lanka (Incorporation) Act No. 23 of 2019 Rules of Management
reasoning: This gazette content contains the rules of management for the Chamber of Construction Industry of Sri Lanka, made under the Chamber of Construction Industry of Sri Lanka (Incorporation) Act, No. 23 of 2019. It establishes regulatory frameworks, membership criteria, and compliance requirements for the construction industry, which falls under legal/regulatory matters rather than government structure/personnel or other specialized categories.
